draft.title: Social, legal and political influences
card: Some influences come from society and government. A business cannot control them, so it must change how it operates to fit them.
changes in what people like, what they value and the age of the population. An ageing population raises demand for health care, and concern about waste pushes firms to cut plastic.
the laws a business must follow, such as rules on workplace safety, minimum wages and fair treatment of customers. Breaking a law can lead to fines or court action.
the policies of government: what it plans, spends money on or offers grants for. A policy is a choice a business can respond to. A law is a rule it must obey.
draft.remember: Society shapes what people want, laws set what a business must do, and policies shape what government encourages.

a.q: A snack maker in Geelong switches to paper bags because more of its buyers now care about plastic waste. What is driving this change?
opts: A change in what customers value
A new law that bans plastic packaging
A government grant for paper packaging
A change in the age of the population
a.why: The firm changed because its buyers' values shifted, which is a social influence. No law or grant is mentioned, so it is not legal or political, and nothing about the buyers' ages has changed.
a.clue: Who asked for the change: buyers or the government?

b.q: The government offers grants to small firms that train apprentices. Tom's plumbing business in Ballarat hires an apprentice to get one. Which influence is this?
opts: Political, because it is a government policy choice
Legal, because the government is the source of it
Legal, because Tom must hire an apprentice by law
Social, because it reflects a change in tastes
b.why: A grant is a government policy that encourages firms but does not force them, so it is a political influence. Coming from the government does not make something legal: a legal influence is a law the business must obey, and Tom could have chosen not to hire anyone.
b.clue: Would Tom break a law if he ignored the grant?

a.best: A change in what customers value

b.best: Political, because it is a government policy choice
